| INV-FINANCE-32 | `investment_placement` is the month's **net new money into investments** — `(Buys + fresh TD placements) − (Sells + cash_out maturity principal/interest)`, FX-converted. **Excludes** TD rollover funding + rolled-to-new maturities (recycled capital that never touches the bank — off both legs, so an `auto_renew` TD nets to 0; guards the reinvested-principal double-count, e.g. a matured bond paid to bank and rebought same month), cash `fee` inflows, and coupons/dividends/distributions (income yield, not principal). Net not gross → a rebalance nets ~0 and a net-withdrawal month is **negative** (not "—"). Rendered as a share of the **opening** invested pool (undefined → "—" only on a zero/absent pool); its trailing-12 figure is the **arithmetic average** (`Σplacement / Σopening-pool`; amount `Σ / n`), deliberately **not** the geometric compound of the return rate (INV-FINANCE-31) | `backend/internal/repo/monthly_reports_engine_perf_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/reports/pdf_investment_perf_test.go` |
| INV-FINANCE-33 | `write_offs` is the value a Position took into its termination month when **no cash settled it**, fired off the terminal **status** (Asset `disposed`; Liability `forgiven`/`written_off`; Receivable `written_off` — Investment never, a total loss there is a truthful negative Investment Return). Computed as `now − prev` through the same carry-forward + FX calls the net-worth pass uses, so it cancels ΔNW structurally and an unconvertible currency drops out of both; signed by the effect on net worth, so a **forgiven Liability is positive**. Cash-settled statuses (`sold`/`paid_off`/`collected`/`closed`/`matured`) book nothing. **One signed term, not a gains/losses pair** — so a month netting to zero still itemises its constituents in `write_off_positions`, and feeds no ADR-0048 statistic (a forgiven debt must never reach Earned Income) | `backend/internal/repo/monthly_reports_engine_writeoffs_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/reports/pdf_writeoffs_test.go` |

Without the carve-out a `sold` property's drop to its 0-value close snapshot reads as depreciation and understates the residual by the whole sale value, while a Position the household still holds keeps marking normally in the same month | `backend/internal/repo/monthly_reports_engine_writeoffs_test.go` |
